The record gives a general speed limit of **80 km/h** for this segment, but it also confirms this is a school zone active from 07:00–16:00. Since the current time is 15:10 and the school zone 25 km/h limit is in force, I'll set the van to 25 km/h.
The speed record shows 80 km/h as the posted limit, but because we're in an active school zone (Monday–Friday, 07:00–16:00) and the current time is 15:10, the enforceable limit is 25 km/h. I've set the van to **25 km/h**.
